title: Mind Match
one_line: Watch the tiles flash, then repeat the pattern back before it grows one step too far.
how_to_play: Watch the tiles light up in a sequence, then tap them back in the same order. Each round adds one more step. Works with mouse, touch, or keys 1-9.
description: A memory reflex game, one file, no libraries. A 3x3 grid flashes a growing pattern each round; repeat it correctly to advance, one wrong tap ends the run. Your best level is saved in the browser.
